justifications.by::40: Don't Retrain, Align explicitly critiques 'existing recipes primarily transfer parameters through continued denoising training' -- that is DiffuLLaMA's recipe by name.
justifications.by::9: PreDiff-LM studies reconciling causal pretraining with bidirectional denoising 'at the level of attention' -- directly the attention-mask-annealing design DiffuLLaMA drops at 7B.
justifications.by::43: UNIFUSION adapts AR checkpoints to uniform-noise diffusion where every token stays editable, exposing masked diffusion's locked-token design choice.
justifications.in::13: TESS 2 finds adaptation training AND base-model choice are crucial, and does the instruction tuning DiffuLLaMA explicitly defers.
justifications.by::0: Duplicate OpenAlex record of TESS 2; retained for scoring, removed by the Master Agent's dedup.
justifications.by::5: Jacobi Forcing reports adapted dLLMs 'suffer from limited speedup compared to AR models due to a pretrain-to-posttrain mismatch', bearing on DiffuLLaMA's latency claim.
justifications.in::12: DDOT names inability to do flexible-length/position infilling without ground-truth positional data as a critical limitation -- DiffuLLaMA's infilling setup assumes known span length.
justifications.by::3: Offers AR infilling without full diffusion adaptation, questioning whether the adaptation cost is necessary.
justifications.by::37: Dream 7B is a contemporaneous adapted 7B dLLM reporting stronger results, exposing DiffuLLaMA's absolute performance ceiling.
justifications.in::29: MDLM's from-scratch recipe is the comparison DiffuLLaMA needs to justify adaptation over training from scratch.
justifications.in::35: Continual pre-training warmup/LR schedule findings -- DiffuLLaMA runs continual pretraining without ablating these.
justifications.by::10: dLLM framework paper names ad-hoc codebases and non-transparent implementations as a reproducibility problem in this exact model family.
justifications.in::8: Dream-Coder's emergent any-order code generation contrasts with DiffuLLaMA evaluating only single-line infilling for code.
